label: extension

args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am organising a group stay at City Hub Tokyo and would like to enquire about availability for a group of 10 people in June.

Could you please let me know:
- Whether you have availability for 10 guests in June, and which dates would be possible
- What room types/accommodation options you can offer for a group of this size
- Your group booking rates and any special offers for group stays
- Any additional details or requirements for making a group reservation

I look forward to hearing from you soon.

Kind regards,
Emma Johnson
Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923
args.subject: Group Booking Enquiry - Availability for 10 People in June
